page.layout: One page of text: a Greek verb conjugation table in three columns of forms, with a column of grammatical labels at the right. Running head at top, page number at top right. No notes.
page.notes: Greek forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; accents and breathings in particular are uncertain. Labels in the right column are Latin tense names, with a 'ω' or 'α/β' style marker after Infinitum. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The printed "Infinitū 1." and "Infinitū 2." labels are read as printed.
